entities.name: 2022–2023 Middle East and Mediterranean Sea UAP incident
entities.description: Three UAP reports filed by theater UAV operators after missions in the Middle East and the Mediterranean Sea in 2022 and 2023, in which infrared video seemed to show an atmospheric wake or anomalous propulsion; resolved by AARO as prosaic aircraft with a sensor artifact.

entities.name: second "Atmospheric Wakes" Case Two object, oblong in appearance
entities.description: Second UAP in Case Two; appeared oblong due to camera aberration, unidentified but assessed as probably a small aircraft

entities.description: UAP in Case Three; identified as a specific Airbus A380 commercial aircraft on a recognized travel corridor
